value.rationale: The 3-by-n rectangle is the first genuinely three-row ballot-word family beyond Catalan two-row paths. Width three has six vanishing degree-two characters, yet width four completely protects quadratic characters while retaining a 3996-dimensional convolution nullspace, whose first possible frequencies are eight explicit cubic ones. The exact rank 527445 of the 531441-dimensional natural group algebra is an interpretable, non-implied benchmark for low-order character recovery rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. It provides a reproducible boundary for future degree-of-cancellation and higher-width problems, without claiming them solved.
